row: Cloud-only C1 + CX: optional Mac-source negotiation; execution disabled until X1
providers: CX hub (WS-3a): controller side of the protocol
CX controller (WS-2): staging writer, reconcile sandbox, generation 1

device_hub.dev_fallback: ws://127.0.0.1:<port>/v1 (dev builds only, SSM port forwarding)
device_hub.frames: JSON text frames carrying one envelope each; binary frames only for artifact chunks (README §3.4)

signing.device: ES256 (P-256, SHA-256), IEEE P1363 r||s, 64 bytes, unpadded base64url

reserved.0180: WS-1: atum_private.device_services, atum_private.cloud_controller_signing_keys (reserved as 0176 in C0; renumbered because 0174-0177 were taken by other lanes)

migration_chunks.frame: a binary frame, the artifact chunk's layout: u16 headerLength || utf8(canonicalJson(migration_chunk.header)) || bytes, big-endian
migration_chunks.order: in order from offset 0, contiguous, each at most migration_chunk_max_bytes and each whole frame within the hub's 1 MiB
migration_chunks.integrity: unsigned; the identity-signed offer's archive.bytes and archive.sha256 are the check (case.migration_upload)

staging.sealing: atum.agent-home/1 s3.sealing with object kind 'staging' and the archive's SHA-256 (hex)
staging.retention: never deleted by the controller (the executor role has no s3:DeleteObject); expiry of staging/ is an S3 lifecycle rule owned by hosting (HO); a staged archive is never hydrated as a home

reconcile.where: a task sandbox with no model grant, no egress grant and no network, ended at migration_reconcile_ms from entering reconciling (reconcile_failed); each archive is hydrated into its own scratch home first
reconcile.label: [A-Za-z0-9-]{1,24} (the tool refuses anything else): a short name for the other Mac that the owner can recognise; it ends every skills.bothKept[].otherName as <name>.<label>

report_mapping.entries past a list's cap: omitted (a count); replaced lists every such file; more than 16 fails reconciliation (reconcile_failed), never truncates or counts a replaced file in omitted

hold.mac: a Mac keeps the agent's writers quiesced from its export until a MigrationResult failed or abandoned, or until its clock passes its holdUntil plus skew_ms; it puts them back at once when its offer is refused or after its own MigrationDecline; on committed it leaves them quiesced until that same time (the switch to cloud fences them); absolute-clock expiry assumes its clock stays within skew_ms of the controller; otherwise it keeps writers quiesced for at least migration_hold_ms plus skew_ms on a monotonic clock from the latest MigrationRequest or MigrationAck send receipt
hold.initiator: MigrationAck send carries holdUntil: the controller's receipt of the initiator's offer plus migration_hold_ms, set once when the migration opens
hold.participant: MigrationRequest and the participant's MigrationAck send MUST carry the same migration's holdUntil; a Mac never shortens its stored hold on another frame and keeps the later value if they differ (a controller defect)
hold.controller: never commits after the earliest holdUntil of the Macs whose snapshots it staged: MigrationReport.expiresAt <= that holdUntil - migration_commit_ms (abandoned, expired, when no time is left), a choice is accepted only up to expiresAt, and learn is sent only within migration_commit_ms of accepting it (commit_failed after)
hold.lease: the controller holds the agent's answering lease only while committing: it takes it after accepting the choice and releases it right after learn or on failed; a lease it cannot take (held: false) fails the migration commit_failed

device_to_controller.description: Frames a Mac's device service sends the controller hub.

controller_to_device.description: Frames the controller sends a Mac. Model and egress bearer tokens are never device authority.

device_local.description: Records the device keeps in its own vault; never on the wire.

owner_to_platform.description: The owner's native client to DA. The owner is the introspected principal.

controller_to_platform.description: The controller to DA with its credential; DA derives owner and agent from the executor.

conformance.description: Typed test vectors and admission cases; not wire payloads.
